verses.72:12: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبࣰ ا

meaning: The root هرب (haraba) primarily means "to flee" or "run away." It can refer to a person or animal escaping. A less common meaning is "to become extremely old or decrepit," similar to هرم.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
